display.purpose: Section titles (Standings, How plans fail, Method), uppercase; scope captions go beneath, never above.

headline.purpose: The one-line question in the top strip, the page's h1.

title.purpose: Method step titles and the run-facts and limits heads, uppercase.

body.purpose: Reading copy such as the mode explanation, at most 72ch.

body-dense.purpose: Copy inside the rail and the standings definitions.

caption.purpose: The scope line under a section title, in sage gray.

note.purpose: Unit states, the map caption and small print, in sage gray.

label.purpose: Engraved labels that name a panel, uppercase, in sage gray.

control.purpose: Switch keys; the same small caps run 11.5 to 13px for column heads, nav and definition terms.

readout.purpose: Finish times, gaps, verdicts and counts; place labels on the map.

flap.purpose: Characters on medium split-flap cells (18 by 30px): the standings and the replay clock.

flap-small.purpose: Characters on small split-flap cells (15 by 23px): the plate and the message board.

alert-tag.purpose: Paged alert tags on the map, uppercase; the only bold on the site.

shadows.name: wall-mount
shadows.purpose: Panels hung on the map wall: the rail and the message board.

shadows.name: board-housing
shadows.purpose: The standings housing: a black box with a faint top lip.

shadows.name: flap-ledge
shadows.purpose: Each flap cell's lower edge and drop.

shadows.name: pressed-bar
shadows.purpose: State mark, not depth: the ink bar along the bottom of a pressed key.

shadows.name: map-text-halo
shadows.purpose: text-shadow for text set directly on the map; the only halo in the system.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Press feedback: switch keys scale to 0.97 (120ms), the speed key to 0.95 (120ms), Play to 0.94 (140ms).

motion.name: flap-fall
motion.purpose: The upper leaf falls (rotateX 0 to -90deg) over the first half of a flap step; 180px perspective.

motion.name: flap-land
motion.purpose: The lower leaf lands (rotateX 90 to 0deg) over the second half of a flap step.

motion.name: flap-step
motion.purpose: One drum glyph per step: 70ms by default, 64ms on the board, 60ms on the plate and message board, 90ms for the single step of the replay clock.

motion.name: flap-stagger
motion.value: 11ms to 16ms per cell, 55ms per board row
motion.purpose: Cells flip left to right (11ms on the board, 14ms by default, 16ms on the message board, 40ms on the plate); board rows start 55ms apart; the phone summary line trails its row by 200ms.

motion.name: flap-drum-steps
motion.purpose: Glyphs shown on the way to a new character: 5 on the plate, 3 on the phone summary line, 1 on the clock.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Text and fill color changes on hover.

motion.name: lamp
motion.purpose: A lamp filling at the moment an outcome is decided.

motion.name: unit-dim
motion.purpose: Other units dimming to 40% in the list (about a quarter on the map) while one is hovered or focused.

motion.name: alert-pulse
motion.purpose: An alert ring contracts from a 31px to a 9px radius and fades from 100% to 35%; it never loops.

motion.name: replay-rate
motion.value: 6 or 18 replay minutes per second, linear
motion.purpose: Replay time, toggled by the speed key.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Flips show the final value at once, the replay opens on its final state without autoplay, and smooth scrolling is off.

breakpoints.name: rail-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: rail 360px, small flap cells 12 by 20px, method in two columns.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: the wall stacks (map, then rail), strip 52px, the board scrolls sideways, the nav keeps Replay, Standings and Code.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: the question hides, the nav keeps Code, method in one column, medium flap cells 15 by 25px.

narrative.overview:
LLMuni is a dispatch floor at night. San Francisco is the wall: a full-bleed 3D map drawn in the console's own slate, where each model is a unit sent across the city on its own clock, the provably optimal plan runs in gold, and failures page in as alerts. Around the wall sits the equipment: matte control-room slate with a green-black cast (never blue), engraved 1px hairlines, sage-gray small-caps labels, and a split-flap board of real cells, lettered in Barlow Condensed like California transit signage.

The system is dense and exact, closer to an instrument panel than to a marketing page. Color is scarce and each color carries one meaning: gold is the optimal plan, red is a failure, sage is done, unlit gray is can't be checked, and seven unit colors kept clear of gold and red tell the models apart. Controls are neutral keys in rocker groups; the only filled key is the warm-white Play. Motion is mechanical: replay time runs linear, flaps drop fast and staggered by column, alerts pulse once and never loop, and reduced motion swaps every flip for its final value.

The world refuses the category default of a white leaderboard table over a hero-metric row, and it has no glow and no glass. The Remotion video (video/src/lib/theme.ts, video/src/lib/Flap.tsx) is a second surface of the same system: the same palette, the same two faces, the same flap cell.
keyCharacteristics: Matte green-black slate, with groups divided by engraved 1px hairlines instead of boxes.
Lamp colors with fixed meanings: gold optimal, red failed, sage done, gray unverifiable.
Real split-flap cells for the headline, the standings, the replay clock and the plate.
One family in two widths: Barlow Condensed for signage, Barlow for reading, tabular numerals throughout.
A full-bleed 3D map wall with panels hung on it.
Mechanical motion: linear time, fast staggered flips, single alert pulses.
Small physical corners (4px at most); no glow, no glass.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Gold is the provably optimal plan and nothing else; red is a failure and nothing else. In lamps and bars, sage always means done and unlit gray always means can't be checked.

rules.name: The Separate Channels Rule
rules.body: The seven unit colors only identify models: a model's route, its moving head and the swatch beside its name. They never fill a bar, a lamp or a word, and no lamp or failure color ever draws a model's route.

rules.name: The Alert Ink Rule
rules.body: Red words are set in alert ink; alert red is for marks: lamps, dots, rings and bar fills.

rules.name: The Signage Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is the console's signage: titles, labels, keys, column heads, readouts, flap characters and map tags. Barlow carries everything read as prose: sentences, definitions, names, states and notes.

rules.name: The Engraved Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are condensed small caps in sage gray, tracked 0.1 to 0.14em. A label names a panel, a control group or a column; it never sits above a heading as a kicker.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every numeral is tabular, so clocks, percentages and costs hold their columns while the replay runs and the board flips.

rules.name: The Mounted Panel Rule
rules.body: Only mounted things cast shadows: wall panels, flap-board housings and flap cells. Everything else is flat and divided by hairlines.

rules.name: The No Glow, No Glass Rule
rules.body: Nothing blurs what is behind it and no color glows; panels on the map stay near-opaque (the rail is 96%). The only halo is dark, behind text on the map.

rules.name: The Lamp And Swatch Rule
rules.body: A circle is a lamp, the Play key or a point on the map; a model's swatch is a short bar that echoes its route.

rules.name: The Real Flap Rule
rules.body: A split-flap value is always real cells, with two-tone halves, a hairline split and warm-white characters that flip through the drum; never a font imitation or an image.

rules.name: The Linear Time Rule
rules.body: Replay time runs linear, at 6 or 18 replay minutes per second; flaps are fast and mechanical, staggered by column; alerts pulse once and never loop. Under reduced motion, flips land at once and the replay opens on its final state instead of playing.

dos: Do reserve gold (#f0a500) for the provably optimal plan: its 5px route above every model, its name, its swatch and its lamp.
Do mark failure in red only: alert red (#e5484d) for lamps, dots, rings and closed-store fills; alert ink (#ff8f8a) for failure words.
Do post headline measurements, the standings and the replay clock in real flap cells, each value with a plain-text twin for screen readers.
Do name panels, control groups and columns with engraved labels: Barlow Condensed 600, uppercase, tracked 0.1 to 0.14em, in sage gray (#8d9f98).
Do divide groups with 1px hairlines (#26332f between panels and sections, #1b2624 inside them) instead of boxes.
Do hang panels on the map wall at a 20px inset with the wall-mount shadow, and frame the camera so the routes stay clear of them.
Do theme every browser surface from the palette: a 2px flap-ink focus ring at a 2px offset, a done-sage selection at 32%, slate scrollbars, underlines in sage gray at a 3px offset, tabular numerals.
Do assign the seven unit colors in the run's model order, and draw baselines without color.
donts: Don't use gold or red for a control, link, heading, focus ring or decoration.
Don't show the standings or the headline as a light table or a big-number stat row; they belong on flap boards in dark housings.
Don't put an engraved label above a heading as a kicker; a section title stands alone, with its caption beneath.
Don't add glow or glass: no backdrop blur and no colored halos.
Don't fill a key with color: a pressed key is pressed slate with an ink bar, and the only filled key is the warm-white Play.
Don't loop an alert pulse or add ambient motion; the console moves when replay time runs, a value changes or a key is pressed.
Don't round a panel, housing, switch key or flap cell past 4px.
Don't borrow SFMTA, Muni or BART marks or official styling; LLMuni is independent research.
